instruction: Create a comprehensive report from the most recent five emails in Thunderbird's daily folder with three columns: sender name, subject, and whether the email has a CC recipient (Yes/No). Save this report as 'email_analysis.xlsx' on the Desktop using LibreOffice Calc.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('alt', 'tab'); time.sleep(0.3); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(1)

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating 3-column report (sender, subject, has CC) from 5 most recent emails. Verified: Jan 25,29,30 have no CC (No), Jan 27,28 have CC (Yes). Evaluator checks Excel contains all 3 columns with correct data.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts 3 columns (sender, subject, has_cc) from Excel file at specified path
Metric correctly compares row-by-row with partial credit scoring
Expected values are semantically correct - verified from actual email data with correct CC status
Postconfig appropriately saves the file with Alt+Tab + Ctrl+S before verification
Complete coverage - all 3 required columns are verified against expected data
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding header validation to verify row 1 contains appropriate column names (Sender, Subject, Has CC)
Add explicit None/empty cell handling in getter to avoid tuple comparison issues with missing data
Consider validating that exactly 5 rows of data are present (not counting header)
